body: The rule 'the music server's [Unknown Album] bucket is not a release; show it as Songs without an album, and a song of it as a song with no album' lives in the app today (app/lib/domain/album_names.dart, PR 136). A browser inherits it (same Flutter code), but a TV app or any other client would not. When the rulebook is written, the server should own it: normalise the bucket in the server's answers so every client gets it for free.
